issue.title: [Bug][202405] : Error logs due to unsupported egress acl feature on fabric cards

failure.body:
### Issue Description

This error log was captured when running the drop_packets tests in sonic-mgmt on our T2 topology testbed. It can be reproduced by running `drop_packets/drop_packets.py::test_drop_counters::test_ip_pkt_with_expired_ttl`

Here attribute 37 (see log below) corresponds to `EGRESS_ACL` attribute and is being called on a fabric card. Fabric cards do not support this feature and hence these error logs are being generated. A quick fix would be to whitelist these errors.

### Results you see

```
2024 Dec  8 <IPV6>.215732 cmp227 ERR syncd1#syncd: [10:00.0] SAI_API_SWITCH:brcm_sai_get_switch_attribute:6654 Get switch attrib 37 failed with error Feature unavailable (0xfffffff0).
	 E
	 E               2024 Dec  8 <IPV6>.231510 cmp227 ERR syncd3#syncd: [1a:00.0] SAI_API_SWITCH:brcm_sai_get_switch_attribute:6654 Get switch attrib 37 failed with error Feature unavailable (0xfffffff0).
	 E
	 E               2024 Dec  8 <IPV6>.512532 cmp227 ERR syncd8#syncd: [31:00.0] SAI_API_SWITCH:brcm_sai_get_switch_attribute:6654 Get switch attrib 37 failed with error Feature unavailable (0xfffffff0).
	 E
	 E               2024 Dec  8 <IPV6>.645790 cmp227 ERR syncd10#syncd: [3b:00.0] SAI_API_SWITCH:brcm_sai_get_switch_attribute:6654 Get switch attrib 37 failed with error Feature unavailable (0xfffffff0).
	 E
	 E               2024 Dec  8 <IPV6>.810033 cmp227 ERR syncd7#syncd: [2e:00.0] SAI_API_SWITCH:brcm_sai_get_switch_attribute:6654 Get switch attrib 37 failed with error Feature unavailable (0xfffffff0).
```

### Results you expected to see

We expect to see no errors.

### Is it platform specific

broadcom
